record.question: Which was the first national association organised in 1928 international interest in medical record?
options: The Canadian Association of Medical Record Librarian
record.explanation: Official final key: A — The American Medical Record Association. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 3, printed Q37. Source limitation: None of the options correctly names the 1928 association. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
